test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0925ad2ff25870c0413e948417e05e6e2bd3a82d9d25f267f6f25b9be87986ef.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c427f736d01b61ca400f1283ebf39497f3c8aa4763a6e45a1a8622ae666b8fe0.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) For first box series →

The right diagonal elements interchange positions.

The second element of 3rd column is replaced by new element subsequently.

The rest of the elements shifts anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f3e9ae265e5850ae14985fa8f05598af6a524db79e4b03450d6d59cbcf6e154.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7ec7e0612a850ad1b20a507d5a850fc42d42ea2063b2d40e4c604e9ff112fc0.png] 

2) For second box series →

The elements at the corners shifts clockwise.

The rest of the elements shifts anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bc15075fdede6a61881b5e36166312b4e767c61a191ca490c81a4e059e712de.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e7642398fa6f70aefa7c1d5fda847525dc0864624bfb0209b503375e850e812.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba8d851b11fbab7da8fcf131f21c87cf404af39fd97c7ace2459cc12320888fd.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/411f6e6e8c30ed0efa5c1d724e6d104098aa9141e32c1ad42fdc2dfbf808bb5f.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
